about: JetBrains' Kotlin language server, so a session sees Kotlin errors as it edits. Carries its own Java.
label: Kotlin language server
name: kotlin-lsp

checksum.why: its address is GitHub's answer naming the release; the server it fetches is checked against JetBrains' .sha256 by its own install command

run: v="$(sed -n 's#.*"tag_name": *"kotlin-lsp/v\([0-9.]*\)".*#\1#p' "$1" | head -1)"; [ -n "$v" ] || { echo 'no kotlin-lsp release named in the answer' >&2; exit 1; }; a=''; [ "$(uname -m)" = aarch64 ] && a='-aarch64'; t="$(mktemp -d)"; u="https://download.jetbrains.com/language-server/kotlin-server/$v/kotlin-server-$v$a.tar.gz"; curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$t/k.tgz" "$u"; want="$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$u.sha256" | cut -d" " -f1)"; got="$(sha256sum "$t/k.tgz" | cut -d" " -f1)"; [ -n "$want" ] && [ "$want" = "$got" ] || { echo "the kotlin server is not what JetBrains says it is (sha256 $got, expected ${want:-none stated})" >&2; exit 1; }; mkdir -p "$2/server" "$2/bin"; tar -xzf "$t/k.tgz" -C "$2/server" --strip-components=1; ln -sfn ../server/bin/intellij-server "$2/bin/kotlin-lsp"; rm -rf "$t"
